facts.text: Snow left Lobdell Lake (9,260 ft) and Summit Meadow (9,360 ft) 12 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Lobdell Lake
evidence.detail: left April 17; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), May 5 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Summit Meadow
evidence.detail: left May 6; earlier seasons: July 2 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 11 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Lobdell Lake (9,260 ft) and Summit Meadow (9,360 ft).

evidence.name: Lobdell Lake
evidence.detail: 1.5 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 52.1 in (2023), 14.8 in (2024), 13.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Summit Meadow
evidence.detail: 3.3 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 62.0 in (2023), 20.3 in (2024), 15.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 19 and April 30, carried from the melt-out dates at Lobdell Lake (9,260 ft) and Summit Meadow (9,360 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Lobdell Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 17, 1,740 ft above the pass; points to February 11 to April 21

evidence.name: Summit Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 6, 1,840 ft above the pass; points to February 28 to May 9
